differences: First arm minus subtract arm, paired within seed. Means give each seed equal weight.
interpretation: A change in volume, population, or stock alone does not establish welfare.

metric_notes.eaten: Resident meals eaten. A positive difference means more total meals.
metric_notes.private_delivered: Domestic private cargo units delivered across all goods.
metric_notes.road_used: Used capacity of domestic roads, counted once per road and year.
metric_notes.unmet: Unmet resident food units. A decrease is improvement on this measure; an increase is worsening.
